claims.statement: Alfred Greenfield, the English heavyweight, issued a challenge to fight Tom Allen for £200 or £500, or for a £1,000 champion trophy.

claims.statement: Tom Allen posted a forfeit and agreed to meet Alfred Greenfield if Greenfield would fight in a sixteen-foot ring.
claims.excerpt: Alicn has posted a forfeit, and agrees to meet Greenfield

claims.statement: The proposed Allen-Greenfield match was to be for £200 a side and a champion cup valued at £200, in a sixteen-foot ring (printed as 'sixteen-toot') instead of a twenty-four-foot ring (printed as 'twenty-loar-foot').
